aiRouting.title: AI Feature Routing
aiRouting.subtitle: Which model each AI feature's jobs run on, in fallback order — the single source of truth every tenant and farmer uses
aiRouting.loadError: Could not load the AI routing registry.
aiRouting.noJobs: No jobs under this feature yet.
aiRouting.writeNote: Changes here take effect for every tenant and farmer within seconds. The model list for a job only offers models the registry will accept for it. Jobs are never deleted — switch one off with Active instead. Every save needs a reason and is written to the change history.
aiRouting.chainHint: The first model answers; the rest are tried in order if it fails. Only models the registry accepts for this job are listed.
aiRouting.chainEmpty: No model set. While the job is Active it must have at least one.
aiRouting.addModel: Add a model to the chain
aiRouting.addModelHelp: A model is offered only if it is active or deprecated, accepts this job's input types, and accepts this job's reasoning effort.
aiRouting.noEligibleModels: No model in the catalog can serve this job as configured. Widen the job's input types, change its reasoning effort, or activate a suitable model first.
aiRouting.activeNeedsModel: An active job must have at least one model. Switch the job off first, or add a model.
aiRouting.breaksChain: That change would break the current chain: {{problem}}
aiRouting.settingsHint: These are the request settings the router sends for this job, and whether the job runs at all.
aiRouting.inputsHelp: What the job sends the model. A job that sends a photo must include image, or a text-only model could be routed to it.
aiRouting.paramsHelp: Leave a field empty to use the model's own default. The registry accepts only these four settings.
aiRouting.preferFreePoolHelp: On: the router tries the chain steps that still have free provider tokens before the ones that would be billed, keeping your order within each group. Off: the chain is tried exactly as you arranged it, whatever it costs.
aiRouting.activeHelp: Off stops the router using this job at all — the feature falls back to its own non-AI behaviour. This is how a job is switched off; jobs are never deleted.
aiRouting.changeReasonHint: e.g. switched to the cheaper model after the October price change
aiRouting.reasonRequired: A reason is required — it is written to the change history.

aiModels.title: AI Models
aiModels.subtitle: The model catalog: every model the platform may route to, with its lifecycle, API contract, price and the jobs using it
aiModels.loadError: Could not load the AI model catalog.
aiModels.noPrice: No active price — cost logs as empty
aiModels.priceUnitNote: Prices are the active ai_model_pricing rows (stored per 1k tokens, shown per 1M). Ledger cost is fixed at call time, so editing a price never changes past reports.
aiModels.writeNote: Add a model a provider has just released, change its status, or set its price — no code change and no migration. A model is never deleted: its usage and cost history reference it, so "removing" one means setting it to Retired, which stops the router using it.
aiModels.addHint: The model id must match the provider's API exactly — it is sent on every request.
aiModels.editHint: Provider and model id cannot change: identity is fixed once a model exists, so a renamed model is a new entry and this one is retired.
aiModels.identityLocked: Provider and model id are permanent once saved. Everything else on this form can be changed later.
aiModels.statusHelp: Candidate: visible but the registry refuses to route to it. Active: routable. Deprecated: still routable, shutdown announced. Retired: no longer routable.
aiModels.inputsHelp: What the model itself accepts. A job that sends photos can only use a model with image.
aiModels.contractHelp: These come from the provider's API reference. Newer reasoning models use max_completion_tokens and reject a custom temperature.
aiModels.reasoningEffortsHelp: Comma separated. Leave empty if the model does not take a reasoning effort — a job asking for one will then be refused.
aiModels.sourceUrlHint: the provider page these details came from
aiModels.priceHint: Enter the provider's published price per million tokens. Stored per 1k, as the registry requires.
aiModels.priceCachedHelp: Leave empty if the provider does not publish a cached-input price.
aiModels.effectiveFromHelp: A new date adds a new price row; past calls keep the price that applied when they ran, so old cost reports never change.
aiModels.changeReasonHint: e.g. added from the provider's October model release page

aiKeys.title: AI API Keys
aiKeys.subtitle: The provider API keys the farmer app's AI router rotates through, with each key's daily complimentary-token pool and today's use
aiKeys.howItWorks: For every call the router uses the first enabled key that still has free-pool room for the model's group; when a key's pool is spent (or it returns a rate limit / no credits) the next key takes over, and when every pool is spent the lowest key carries paid traffic. Pools are counted from our own usage ledger per UTC day (reset 00:00 UTC = 05:30 IST) because the provider gives no signal when free tokens run out. Keys must be used by the router only, or the count is wrong. The key itself is never stored or shown — only the name of the Supabase secret.
aiKeys.loadError: Could not load the API key slots.
aiKeys.noPool: No complimentary pool configured for this key — every call on it is paid.
aiKeys.groupsNote: Groups are seeded from OpenAI's published complimentary-token model lists (fetched 2026-10-02). Verify them against your OpenAI dashboard; edit ai_model_group when OpenAI changes the lists.
aiKeys.label: Label
aiKeys.dailyPool: Daily complimentary pool (tokens per UTC day)
aiKeys.poolHelp: 0 = no free pool for that group on this key (calls are paid). Only an organisation that shares API traffic with OpenAI and holds a positive balance gets complimentary tokens.
aiKeys.reserveHelp: Tokens kept back so a request that would cross the pool is not sent on this key (such a request is billed in full). Must cover the largest single call.
aiKeys.changeReasonHint: Why this change (recorded in the AI change history)
aiKeys.invalidPool: Pool for {{group}} must be a whole number ≥ 0.
aiKeys.invalidReserve: Reserve must be a whole number ≥ 0.
aiKeys.saveError: Could not save the key slot.
